Where each fixture came from. Regenerate from the gateway's own tests once
its External and Loop endpoints land; any difference is a bug on one side.

public-node-external.json
public-node-loop.json
    autognomus 786bd8455783af3eaa1abba2357b5900d6afde1f,
    docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-external-tasks-loops-and-run-visibility-design.md
    section 8.4, rewritten to the resolved shape: internally tagged by
    `kind` as `PublicNode` is, and `retry.attempts` as `RetrySpec` is.

feature-from-ticket.workflow.json
    Written by hand from the dev workflows design (4.3, 4.4) as the body
    vetinari must register for one feature-from-ticket run. `triggers`
    follows autognomus-gateway/src/http/workflows.rs at the same commit.

claim-preflight-first.json
claim-implement-rework.json
claim-open-pr.json
    autognomus 786bd8455783af3eaa1abba2357b5900d6afde1f, engine spec
    section 5.3 (the `Task` a claim replies with) and 5.4 (the loop
    envelope and loop output), with `TaskId` in the resolved
    `<run>~<instance>~<attempt>` form. `config` is the matching node's
    config from feature-from-ticket.workflow.json.
